recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is for R6. No broader Patient Care maturity sweep was attempted; co-listed maturity issues concern other artifacts and should remain separate reconciliation items.
issue_request: FHIR-46519 is an Applied FHIR-core Patient Care change request asking to increase Flag's FMM because it is used in production by many vendors and applications. The final Persuasive resolution says that, in alignment with the September 2025 Patient Care WGM vote, Flag is planned to go normative in R6.
initial_application: No prior commit on the combined branch carried Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-46519, and git history did not show a FHIR-46519-tagged source commit. The current source had been partially aligned by commits 9987f9c0c3 and 5c20769cc7, which changed the Flag resource and Flag.status terminology standards-status values from trial-use to normative, but source/fhir.ini, the Flag StructureDefinition FMM extension, and the directly bound Flag.status CodeSystem/ValueSet FMM extensions still said 1.
additional_context: Flag is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. FHIR versions.html defines FMM 6 as synonymous with normative standards status. The cited September 2025 Patient Care WGM minutes record the R6 normative-resource discussion and a 31-0-1 motion to support the documented feedback to FMG. The March 2026 Zulip maturity-comment thread supports resolving maturity comments based on the R6 normative intention. Searches for Flag/FHIR-46519-specific Zulip discussion found no conflicting evidence. FHIR-46581 was a same-family Patient Care maturity reconciliation already represented on the combined branch and served as a consistency check.
reconciliation: Updated source/fhir.ini and source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml so the authoritative Flag resource maturity is FMM 6. Also updated source/flag/codesystem-flag-status.xml and source/flag/valueset-flag-status.xml from FMM 1 to FMM 6 because Flag.status is required-bound to that Flag-owned terminology and those artifacts already carry normative standards-status.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: changed Flag resource FMM from 1 to 6 while preserving concurrent Goal FMM 6 on the combined branch.
source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml: changed the Flag StructureDefinition structuredefinition-fmm extension from 1 to 6.
source/flag/codesystem-flag-status.xml: changed the normative Flag Status CodeSystem structuredefinition-fmm extension from 1 to 6.
source/flag/valueset-flag-status.xml: changed the normative Flag Status ValueSet structuredefinition-fmm extension from 1 to 6.
